data.name: StatsHow
data.value: The success rate counts units, so a batch of 5 corms where 4 made it counts as 4 of 5. A unit has made it once it's potted up or its batch has rooted, and units still on their way aren't counted either way. Below {0} units the count is shown instead of a percentage, since 2 of 2 says more than 100%. Days to root only uses batches that were marked as rooted, so one that went straight to potted up isn't in it.
data.comment: Explains the numbers on the results page. {0} is the number of units below which a count is shown instead of a percentage. A unit is one cutting, corm or seed in a batch.

data.name: StatsEmptyHow
